entry_requirements: Entrants must be students at a recognized educational institution.
Entrants must be above the legal age of majority in their country of residence.
Entrants must satisfy the geographic requirements displayed on the official site.
Companies, organizers, and judges are excluded.
Solo and team entries are allowed only when every team member is eligible.
submission_requirements: Submit one Devpost entry per project addressing a specific barrier to learning.
Include a project story, screenshots, and an accessible demo, build, or recorded walkthrough.
Identify work created during the event and distinguish it from pre-existing work.
Use synthetic or permission-cleared examples and do not upload private educational records or identifiable learner data.
Credit third-party work and AI assistance.
Do not require judges to provide private personal information to test the demo.
license_observation: No OSI-approved license requirement was stated on the captured rules page. The rules require permission-cleared material and third-party credit.
